name: fence
doc: A fence network (design/planner.md, Walls, fences, and gates): the game gives a kind (a config entry: pickets, rails, split rails, wattle, a hedge, a low stone wall, iron railings) and a network on the hex grid's diagonal lattice, and build makes the whole fence (or one chunk of it) with a post at every node and a swinging gate in each opening; the house animator swings its gates and stirs its hedges.

params.name: kind
params.doc: A kind: one entry from config/fence_kinds/.

params.name: condition
params.doc: Intact, or a ruin: broken and leaning, its gates gone, overgrown.

params.name: network
params.doc: The network to build: an example from config/line_networks/, or the game's own (a planner's line).

params.name: chunks
params.doc: How many chunks to split it into, by angle round its middle (0 or 1: all of it).

params.name: detail
params.doc: Level of detail; the runtime picks it from distance and quality.

params.name: wind_heading
params.doc: Toward which the wind blows, from +Z toward +X.

params.name: door_time
params.doc: Seconds since the gate opened; negative while shut. The game starts it when someone comes through; it opens, stays a moment, and closes.
